הַמִּשְׁכָּן is a common noun (H4908), left as the untranslated form mishkán
Feminine dual of the rear/flank noun is plural fondos, so the pair is lost and the sense shifts toward bottoms.
Feminine ordinal modifies the side, not the masculine tabernacle; masculine el segundo no longer marks that head and can be read with mishkán.
Directional suffix is hacia; the article el is Spanish smoothing. The noun stays mar.

notes: Y, cinco, travesaños, a tablas, and costado match both clauses in conjunction, cardinal, plural bars, preposition plus plural boards, and singular side.
